purpose: Frozen independently authored extension inputs for G1/G3; not installation or compatibility results.

retention: CRX files and inspection evidence are local ignored artifacts. Keep these exact SHA-256 bytes for qualification; the update endpoint returns current versions and blob URLs may expire. A different hash requires an explicit manifest revision.

package_verification.scope: Package integrity and identity checks do not qualify the Chromium installer, verified_contents policy or ordinary install/update. Keep execution evidence outside source commits.
